name: Starlight Silk Road Bridge
description: An arched bridge woven from strands of starlight silk, spanning a luminous river of liquid light.
prompt: A graceful arched bridge made of shimmering silk threads that glow with embedded starlight — each fiber a tiny constellation. Below, a river of liquid light flows, reflecting the bridge. Surrounding landscape is a twilight valley with soft hills. Magical realism, high detail, 8K.
caption: Cross the river on a bridge spun from the night sky. 🌌🌉 #StarlightSilkRoadBridge
